observations.operation: retain the OpenDiskFont result in A2
only the proportional-font rejection path explicitly calls CloseFont on the newly opened font, then clears A2
a NULL id_VolumeNode takes the success path, clears result and IoErr, and enters shared cleanup with A2 still holding the opened font
shared cleanup frees temporary allocations and closes acquired libraries; it does not call CloseFont on A2. The only other CloseFont site closes the previous Window.Font at 0x01F0
post-open process/console lookup failures also reach shared cleanup with A2 non-NULL and do not call CloseFont

candidate_behavior.no_window_success: retains the OpenDiskFont result without CloseFont, matching the captured HUNK path
candidate_behavior.pre_transfer_failure: calls CloseFont to release the candidate font; this is a cleanup improvement over the static HUNK's post-open failure path

evidence_limits: The HUNK's call sites establish the binary control flow; this audit does not measure the guest diskfont open count or prove real handler effects.

The candidate intentionally avoids the HUNK's post-open error-path font leak. Whether that internal ownership difference affects guest-visible compatibility still requires original Workbench execution.
